title: Coupled Fixed Point Theory over Quantale-Valued Quasi-Metric Spaces (QVQMS) with Applications in Generalized Metric Structures
content: In this study, we establish several coupled fixed point results in quantale-valued quasi-metric spaces, which constitutes a generalization of metric and probabilistic metric spaces. The obtained results will be illustrated with concrete examples. Furthermore, we introduce the concept of θs-completeness and, as an application of the main theorems, we derive some results in both quantale-valued partial metric spaces and probabilisic metric spaces.
